files_reviewed.purpose: Published evidence, roadmap and stated limitations

observations: The reviewed repository describes VeriSigilAI/VCB architecture and declared execution-boundary concepts.
The reviewed website files do not identify an executable AI model/agent runtime, model provider/name/version, immutable model artifact digest or repeatable AI invocation path.
Published product trust metrics are not NCS test results and were not treated as model-conduct evidence.
Native Behavior Baseline and Policy Delta execution are blocked pending identification of the actual AI runtime subject.
Application assurance cases have been specified but were not executed in this source-review run.
limitations: This is a repository source review, not runtime testing.
The reviewed repository may link to or depend on executable code hosted in another repository or service.
No inference is made that VeriSigilAI has no AI runtime anywhere; only that it was not established from the reviewed files.
next_action: Locate the actual VCB executable runtime repository or deployed integration code, identify model/agent provider and immutable version, and establish a safe synthetic invocation path.
